findings.detail: Identifier maturity text for IQN Holding Corp. Two says 05/02/2029, but the raw SOI twin row maturity is 05/02/2028.
Identifier maturity text for Atlas US Finco, Inc. One says 12/09/2029, but the raw SOI twin row maturity is 12/10/2029.
Identifier maturity text for Saturn Borrower, Inc. says 11/10/2018, but the raw SOI rows show 11/10/2028.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The raw SOI rows include explicit maturity date cells and repeatedly match the structured XBRL residual dates, while the generated identifier strings in the flag carry different maturity dates. Examples include IQN row 42:19 with 05/02/2028 versus identifier 05/02/2029, Atlas row 33:29 with 12/10/2029 versus identifier 12/09/2029, and Saturn row 45:5 with 11/10/2028 versus identifier 11/10/2018. The defect is therefore a real identifier/extraction mismatch, not a false alarm in the maturity-vs-XBRL check.
